newsitem.title: USA: Federal Express pushes into Russia.
newsitem.headline: Federal Express pushes into Russia.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said on Tuesday that it has launched a Moscow-based international operation that will act as a gateway to Russia and most of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS).
The service will directly link Russian businesses with the FedEx "World On Time" global express network, a statement from the company said.
In what the company called a first for its industry, FedEx said it will be the only U.S. express carrier to use a combination of its own aircraft and customs warehousing service.

This, the company said, will remove the express industry shipment weight restrictions, and FedEx will offer a 10:30 a.m. next business day express service from Moscow to North America and Western Europe.
